create_thread_pool: create a _StandardThreadPool with a specified number of max workers for concurrent task execution
queue_callback_to_thread_pool: queue a callback function with arguments to the thread pool and get a Future result
create_default_thread_pool: create a default _StandardThreadPool using create_default with the local world size for optimal thread count
get_thread_local_storage: get a value from thread-local storage by key with a default factory for lazy initialization
get_num_threads: get the optimal number of threads based on CPU count and the local world size
